question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Please hang with for two minutes while I finish cleaning the utensils.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Please hang with .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Please hang with"** is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"Please hang on"**, which means to wait or hold on for a short period of time.
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct and appropriately conveys the intended meaning.

Correct sentence: *Please hang on for two minutes while I finish cleaning the utensils*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Errors with Phrasal Verbs:**

 
 
• Phrasal verbs like **"hang on"**, **"hang out"**, or **"hang up"** have different meanings. Be mindful of the context.
 
• **"Hang out"** means to spend time socially (e.g., "Let's hang out this weekend").
 
• **"Hang up"** means to end a phone call (e.g., "She hung up the phone").
 
 
 
• Always check phrasal verbs for their correct usage in sentences to avoid confusion or grammatical errors.
